description: Angular component class for configuring settings of a widget that allows updating multiple attributes with various input options, validation, and dynamic form controls.

classes.name: UpdateMultipleAttributesKeySettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing widget settings related to updating multiple attributes, including form initialization, validation, and dynamic control enabling/disabling.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided widget settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables/disables form controls based on current form values for validation.

methods.name: doUpdateSettings
methods.description: Updates form controls with new settings.

methods.name: prepareSelectOptionsFormArray
methods.description: Prepares a form array for select options with validation.

methods.name: selectOptionsFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of select options.

methods.name: trackBySelectOption
methods.description: Track function for select options list rendering.

methods.name: removeSelectOption
methods.description: Removes a select option at specified index.

methods.name: addSelectOption
methods.description: Adds a new select option to the form array.

methods.name: selectOptionDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop reordering of select options.

methods.name: displayErrorMessagesSection
methods.description: Determines whether to display error message configuration section based on current form state.
